findings.title: Fallback locales are only loaded by the controller filter, not by I18n.t
findings.body: The translate override loads only `config.locale` (`load_locale(config.locale)`). The fallback chain's other locales (the site default and :en) are loaded only by `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!`, which is called from `ApplicationController#set_locale`. Any translation made under `I18n.with_locale` outside a web request (Sidekiq jobs, mailers rendered in jobs, rake tasks) therefore has no guarantee that the fallback yml files are loaded. If the key is missing in the requested locale, the lookup falls back to a locale whose translations were never loaded and returns a 'translation missing' string. The fallback behavior depends on which entry point ran first, which is fragile.

findings.title: Loading fallback locales does not invalidate the LRU translation cache
findings.body: The cache at line 71 is keyed only on key, locale, and backend object_id, and is cleared only in `reload!`. Results now depend on which fallback locales are loaded and on `SiteSetting.default_locale`, but neither is in the key. If a lookup runs before the fallback locale (e.g. :en) has been loaded, the 'translation missing' result is frozen into `@cache`. When `ensure_loaded!` later loads :en, that stale entry is still served for that locale until the process restarts. The same staleness applies when an admin changes `default_locale`, since cached fallback output for other locales is not recomputed.

findings.title: Fallback chain is rebuilt and SiteSetting is read on every backend lookup
findings.body: Fallbacks#translate in the i18n gem calls `I18n.fallbacks[locale]` on every backend translate, including the interpolated translations that bypass the LRU cache (`args.length > 0`). Each call reads `SiteSetting.default_locale`, calls `to_sym`, and allocates a new array with `uniq.compact`. This is a small per-translation cost on a hot path. Computing the chain once per locale, or caching it in the hash, would avoid it.

findings.title: No specs for the new fallback chain, ensure_loaded!, or the set_locale change
findings.body: This PR changes locale resolution for the whole application: it adds a custom fallback order (user locale, site default, :en), a new `ensure_loaded!` path in the I18n accelerator, a new call in `set_locale`, and it removes `config.i18n.fallbacks` from three environment files. None of this is covered by a spec. Nothing checks that a missing key falls back in the expected order, that fallback locales get loaded, or that the behavior holds in production and profile environments after the config removal. Given the cache and loading issues above, targeted specs are needed before merge.
